div.head: VIII Atr 1.1
div.ab: And gif æfre ænig man heonan forð Godes ciricgrið swa abrece þæt he binnon ciricwagum mansleaga wurðe, þonne sy þæt botleas, ⁊ ehte his ælc þara þe Godes freond sy, buton þæt gewurðe þæt he þanon ætberste ⁊ swa deope friðsocne gesece þæt se cyningc him þurh þæt feores geunne, wið fulre bote ge wið God ge wið men.

And if ever anyone henceforth violates the protection of the church of God by committing homicide within its walls, the crime shall not be atoned for by any payment of compensation, and everyone who is the friend of God shall pursue the miscreant, unless it happen that he escapes from there and reaches so inviolable a sanctuary that the king, because of that, grant him his life, upon condition that he makes full amends both towards God and men.

⁊ gyf æfre ænig man heonan forð Godes cyricgrið swa abrece, þæt he binnnn cyricwagum manslaga weorðe, þonne sy þæt botleas, ⁊ ehte his ælc þæra þe Godes freond sy, butan þæt geweorðe, þæt he þanan ætberste ⁊ swa deope friðsócne gesece, þæt se cyning him þurh þæt feores geunne, wið fulre bote ge wið Godd ge wið men.
